comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
A few notes from my experience getting these. Unlike most of the rare fleets I've encountered, this one wasn't distinguishable from the other one (the one who drops Freya's drink) by sail color. HOWEVER I can tell you that the ones I got this from were Battle pinnacles, not regular pinnacles.

A summary of my experience: I circled the area for a couple hours in my custom hind. Knowing these fleets had low crew count, I put about 60 sailors onboard. When I engaged the fleet of 4x battle pinnacles, I had a number of Thor's Thunder items from the viking event. Being careful not to wipe out their dura too fast, I hit several of those to force the rare fleet to engage me in melee. I had all rare plunder oxfords on + Sanctus EX. After maybe 5-10 mins in melee, I managed to plunder 2 of these armours XD. 2 more to go and this difficult mem album is a thing of the past for me!

-CadillacShrimpin
